request.subject: UNIT:UNDEAD:FIGHTER

layers.text: Change only the colours of his clothes: the red tabard becomes a ragged near-black charcoal tabard, open at the chest so pale warm ivory ribs show, with a thin bright violet trim along its torn hem; the red helmet crest becomes a bright violet crest; his eye sockets glow bright violet and the small blue flame becomes bright violet. Keep the skull, helmet, sword, shield, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
